info.name: Velzon Admin API
info.description: Repository-verified Postman collection for the NestJS API. API prefix /api/v1. Login stores the access token in the selected environment. Swagger docs JSON is available at {{serverOrigin}}/docs-json. Import the matching local environment.

item.name: 00 - Diagnostics
item.description: Run health check first. Swagger is the canonical contract for request/response schemas.

request.description: Full OpenAPI document generated by NestJS Swagger. URL is outside /api/v1.

item.name: 01 - Authentication
item.description: Run Login before protected requests. Access token is stored in the selected Postman environment.

request.description: Creates a USER role only. Password must contain 12-72 characters. Never accepts a client-supplied role.

item.name: 02 - Business resources
item.description: JWT required. Most business write operations require ADMIN or MANAGER. Lists accept page and limit (max 100), commonly also search.

request.description: Use existing customerId and productId. The server computes prices/totals and decrements stock transactionally.

item.name: 03 - User administration (ADMIN)
item.description: Both endpoints require ADMIN. Roles: ADMIN, MANAGER, USER.

item.name: 04 - CMS administration
item.description: JWT plus action-level CMS permission required. Exact fields are based on the NestJS DTOs. ADMIN bypasses the CMS permission grant check.

request.description: Select a file in form-data. Maximum upload size is CMS_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES (default 25 MiB). Allowed media MIME types are validated by the API.

item.name: 05 - Public CMS (no token)
item.description: These published content and public forms/menu endpoints are anonymous. Public form submission has a per-IP throttle.

request.description: Internal endpoint is excluded from Swagger. Set CMS_JOB_TOKEN in backend and the scheduler. Never expose this variable to frontend JavaScript.
Internal endpoint is excluded from Swagger. Keep CMS_JOB_TOKEN server-side only.
